title: S-adenosylmethionine Synthesis and Stress Granule Formation in Yeast Cultures
summary: This cluster revolves around the synthesis of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and its involvement in methionine metabolism, which is affected by cancer. SAM is synthesized by Sam1 and Sam2, which are expressed in yeast cultures. Sam1 also accumulates in foci, affects 2-deoxyglucose and cycloheximide, and assembles stress granules, which are involved in Ded1. The cluster also includes various organisms and companies involved in research, such as the National Institutes of Health, Karmanos Cancer Institute, and Agilent Technologies.
